const s=ctx.state,gl=ctx.gl;s.canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(1,1);s.c=s.canvas.getContext('2d');s.texture=gl.createTexture();s.program=ctx.utils.createProgram(ctx.utils.FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER,`#version 300 es
precision highp float;in vec2 v_uv;out vec4 outColor;uniform sampler2D u_image;void main(){outColor=texture(u_image,vec2(v_uv.x,1.-v_uv.y));}`);s.mount=()=>{const div=document.createElement('div');div.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:512px;height:512px;overflow:hidden';document.body.appendChild(div);return div;};s.colors=['#57d8c6','#ffbc78','#ad9bff'];const mod=await ctx.utils.import('https://esm.sh/3d-force-graph@1.80.0?bundle&deps=three@0.186.0');const Force=mod.default??mod;s.div=s.mount();s.graph3d=new Force(s.div,{rendererConfig:{antialias:true,alpha:true,preserveDrawingBuffer:true}}).width(512).height(512).backgroundColor('#0b1625').showNavInfo(false).enablePointerInteraction(false).nodeColor(n=>s.colors[n.group]).nodeVal(5).linkColor(()=>'#829daf').linkOpacity(1).warmupTicks(150).cooldownTicks(30);const nodes=Array.from({length:24},(_,i)=>({id:i,group:i%3,x:Math.cos(i/24*Math.PI*2)*40,y:Math.sin(i/24*Math.PI*2)*40,z:(i%3-1)*15})),links=Array.from({length:24},(_,i)=>({source:i,target:(i+1)%24}));for(let i=0;i<8;i++)links.push({source:i,target:i+12});s.graph3d.graphData({nodes,links});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));
script.render: const s=ctx.state,u=ctx.uniforms,c=s.c,gl=ctx.gl,[w,h]=ctx.resolution,m=Math.min(w,h),size=m*.82,left=(w-size)/2,top=(h-size)/2,key=JSON.stringify(u);if(s.error)throw Error(s.error);if(s.canvas.width!==w||s.canvas.height!==h){s.canvas.width=w;s.canvas.height=h;}c.fillStyle='#0b1625';c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);const nodes=s.graph3d.graphData().nodes;const center=['x','y','z'].map(k=>(Math.min(...nodes.map(n=>n[k]||0))+Math.max(...nodes.map(n=>n[k]||0)))/2),radius=Math.max(15,...nodes.map(n=>Math.hypot((n.x||0)-center[0],(n.y||0)-center[1],(n.z||0)-center[2])));if(s.lastWidth!==u.u_width){s.graph3d.linkWidth(u.u_width);s.lastWidth=u.u_width;}s.graph3d.cameraPosition({x:center[0]+Math.sin(u.u_turn)*radius*2.5,y:center[1]+radius*.7,z:center[2]+Math.cos(u.u_turn)*radius*2.5},{x:center[0],y:center[1],z:center[2]},0);s.graph3d.camera().lookAt(...center);s.graph3d.renderer().render(s.graph3d.scene(),s.graph3d.camera());c.drawImage(s.graph3d.renderer().domElement,left,top,size,size);s.note='24 nodes · 32 links · 3D Force Graph renderer';c.fillStyle='#b7c9d8';c.font=Math.max(11,m*.022)+'px sans-serif';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText(s.note||'',w/2,h/2+m*.465);ctx.publish('tool',s.note||'ready');gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,s.texture);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,s.canvas);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.useProgram(s.program);ctx.utils.bindTexture(s.program,'u_image',s.texture,0);ctx.utils.drawFullscreen(s.program);
